# Reproducible public samples

`seasonal-records.json` and `annual-records.json` are GBIF scientific-name occurrence facets retrieved on 8 September 2026 for the coarse centre 53.3, -1.8, roughly 20 km radius, 2021–2026. The seasonal sample selects September. Query construction and filters are in `area_birds_core.js`; these are counts, not individual occurrence records or personal locations. GBIF source/data-use links are in `AREA_BIRDS_V377.md`.

`walking-offer.json` is one route produced by the existing `BurbzWalkingRouteCore.parseOffers` from the actual public Overpass walking-way sample in `/root/burbz-living-map-v373-evidence/actual-walking-ways.json`. It retains source way/node evidence for a disposable active-quest preservation test. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, [ODbL attribution and licence](https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). It is a test sample, not a guarantee of present path access.
